settings.api.heading: Telegram API credentials
settings.api.why: Telegram bots cannot read chat history — they only receive messages while the plugin is running. To catch up on messages that arrived while Obsidian was closed, the plugin signs in as your own account and forwards them to the bot. That sign-in needs an api_id and api_hash, which Telegram issues per account and which you create yourself.
settings.api.step1: Sign in with the phone number of your Telegram account.
settings.api.step3: Choose "API development tools" and fill in the short form. App title and short name can be anything, e.g. "Obsidian sync"; platform "Desktop".
settings.api.step4: Copy api_id and api_hash from the result into the fields below, then press Save and connect.
settings.api.privacy: These credentials identify the application, not you — they do not give anyone access to your account or messages. They are stored in the plugin settings file inside your vault. Leave them empty to run in bot-only mode.
settings.api.hash.desc: The 32-character hash from my.telegram.org. Keep it private.
settings.api.status.missing: Not set — the plugin runs in bot-only mode. Account login, "Process old messages" and downloads over 20 MB are unavailable.
settings.api.status.invalid: api_id must be a number and api_hash must not be empty.
settings.api.status.ready: Credentials saved. Now log in as a user in "Telegram user" above.
settings.api.status.connected: Connected as a user — old message processing is available.
settings.advanced.chats.needsUser: Log in as a user in "Telegram user" above to choose the chats to search.
